note: Iowa DNR state park on bluffs above the Wapsipinicon River, southwest of Anamosa. Shaded campground in the woods south of the river, around a lodge; the river is about 250 m north behind continuous forest. Sites 23-26 are walk-to tent sites. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable-only on ReserveAmerica, 20/30-amp electric, showers; changed season ~May-Sep -> Apr 1-Nov 15 (water off late Oct-May 1), max_rig_ft 26 -> 60 (40-60 ft pull-throughs), added count 25, dump false (none), sewer false, booking.season. Fees unchanged (match RA). Not waterfront stands. Note trimmed.
flags: FEES (no change): the stored surcharges.full_hookup (+$20) prices the one full-hookup site, H21, which the DNR campground map labels 'Host 21'. ReserveAmerica sells it ('Standard Full Hook-Up' $18 off-peak / $32 peak), so it isn't wrong, but every public site is non-electric or 20/30-amp electric.

NOTE: the stored '14 electric-only sites' and 'sites fit RVs up to ~26 ft' are contradicted by ReserveAmerica (11 electric + a 2-site electric buddy pair; 40-60 ft pull-throughs); 'open ~May 1-Sep 30' is contradicted by the campground's Apr 1 - Nov 15 season.

PIN: no ReserveAmerica GIS points for this park. The stored 42.0955,-91.2880 sits among gravel spurs under canopy south of the golf clubhouse, consistent with the loops on the DNR map, but the pads can't be made out individually, so no correction is proposed.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. 'Near Water - no' on every site; the river is ~250 m north behind continuous forest.
